result.finding: No container-level CPU or memory resource limits configured. Only JVM heap limits set via JAVA_OPTS environment variable (-Xmx512m -Xms256m).
evidence: docker-compose.yml: no 'deploy.resources' section for either service (oracle-db or photoalbum-java-app)
Dockerfile: ENV JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx512m -Xms256m' (JVM heap limits only, not container resource limits)
No Kubernetes manifests with resources.limits or resources.requests
values: Oracle DB container: no resource limits
